method: Host clang executes exact original and instrumented csi_window_update bodies, with minimal context and recorded selected-peer callback timestamps. This is not target ABI or radio execution.

near_rejection_prediction.interpretation: Given the callback sequence, SDK window resets interrupt feature support despite continued frames; this is consistent with the independently replayed retained-reference expiry.

limitations: Conditional prediction assumes the selected callback rows passed LTF/shape and preprocessing admission; the historical capture does not contain actual SDK branch events.
Matching every observed support identity strengthens timing attribution but does not replace the new on-device branch/timeout observations.
One additional predicted/numerical window has no recorded model feature and is retained as unmatched; no model observation is manufactured.
No ICMP send/reply identity, complete raw PHY metadata, ping-timeout cause, original drift fix, detector quality, stationary presence or CPU-cost parity is qualified.
